Name: Suitcase Record Player
Author: Medinaquirin
Description:
I'd been planning on making a record player for the furniture tilesheet for awhile now, so imagine my delight when 1.4 gave a way to make it functional!  Sadly this is a texture replacement and not a standalone object, but if I ever manage to make that option workable, I'll add it.

Comes in four color variations that can be changed in the config file: blue, red, leather, and canvas.  Config sets it to canvas by default.

As you might expect, this will not work with a game version below 1.4, since the mini-juke did not exist then.

[b]By request: [/b]Added a floor version to replace the boombox object acquired from Sam's 14 heart event!  This can be enabled or disabled through the config and has the same range of color options.

Instructions:

1. Unzip the contents of the zip file into your mods folder.
2. Run game to generate config.
3. Invite Harvey over for coffee and smooth jazz.
